name: MOSS-Image Edit
author: michaeldune
description: Edit a picture with a sentence, on the same MOSS-Image weights the MOSS-Image pack already downloads. Colour, outfit, lighting, season and visual style: say what to change and what to keep, and the composition, the large structure and any lettering stay put. Its own download is 283 MB, the chinoll Moss-Image-Edit LoRA, so if you have the MOSS-Image pack this card costs you almost nothing. Honest about its limits: small objects are redrawn rather than recoloured (a bicycle changes colour but can come back with a different frame, or gain a basket), a 'change only X' instruction can spill onto a neighbouring surface, and fine texture softens a little. Pick the aspect ratio that matches your picture: a different ratio centre-crops it first, and on a mismatched ratio the edit degrades noticeably, lettering included. Needs a SimpliGen engine with the MOSS-Image edit nodes, which landed in ComfyUI on 22-23 October, after the v0.42.1 tag.

presets.name: MOSS-Image Edit
presets.tagline: Change one thing; the lettering survives
presets.description: Give it a picture and a sentence. Name the change and name what to keep: "Change only the dark green paintwork to deep navy blue. Keep both signs, their lettering, the bread in the window and the brickwork exactly as they are." Colour, outfit, lighting, season and visual-style changes all work, and text in the picture comes through letter-exact even under a full restyle. Pick the aspect ratio that matches your picture — on a mismatched ratio it is centre-cropped first and the edit gets looser.

extraModels.description: chinoll Moss-Image-Edit LoRA (adapter_model), 283 MB. Weight licence undeclared on the model card; the project code is GPL-3.0 and the MOSS-Image base is Apache-2.0.

requirements.notes: Weights: the same three files the moss-image pack uses (MOSS-Image SFT int8 ConvRot 5.4 GB, Qwen3.5 9B w4a8 7.3 GB, Flux 2 autoencoder 0.31 GB) plus chinoll's Moss-Image-Edit LoRA (283 MB). A user who already has the MOSS-Image pack downloads only the LoRA. Graph: core nodes only, no custom node beyond rgthree; CLIPLoader type moss_image, TextEncodeMOSSImageEdit with edit_format Moss-Image-Edit, the reference scaled to the output size, ConditioningZeroOut as the negative, CFG 1, 30 steps, euler/simple, SkipLayerGuidanceDiTSimple layer 22 over the whole run; NO ModelSamplingSD3 (MOSS samples with multiplier 1.0). NEEDS a ComfyUI at or after 9fe7ef76 (2026-10-23, PR 17320): `image_strength` on TextEncodeMOSSImageEdit is a REQUIRED input despite its default, so the graph is rejected on the 60aade0b engine that first added the node (PR 17296, 10-22). Neither commit is in any tagged release as of 2026-10-23 (newest tag v0.42.1, 10-19); minComfyuiVersion is set to v0.43.0 on the ASSUMPTION that the next tag carries them, which is unverified - confirm the real gate before release. TESTED 2026-10-23 engine-direct on a 4070 Ti 12 GB, vanilla ComfyUI fb3befd1: 18 arms over 3 sources x 3 instruction types x 2 seeds, plus 3 no-LoRA controls and a CFG sweep, about 15 s per 1 MP picture; this pack file's own workflow was then run through the app's substitution rules on the same engine, 21 s at 1184x896. Lettering came through letter-exact in 6 of 6 arms on a shopfront with two signs, including a flat-vector restyle and a rainy-evening relight; winter, night and relight conversions kept houses, cars and framing in place; faces held on colour and style edits. CFG 1 was tested against CFG 2.5 on all 18 arms and is both 1.79x faster and more faithful to 'keep this unchanged'. Known: small objects are redrawn rather than recoloured (a recoloured bicycle came back with different frame geometry, and one seed added a basket it was not asked for); 'change only the paintwork' also repainted a neighbouring wooden sign at CFG 2.5, fixed at CFG 1; fine texture softens (linen weave became smooth crepe). Also: on an aspect ratio that does NOT match the source the reference is centre-cropped and the edit gets markedly looser - a 1:1 render of a 4:3 shopfront repainted the wooden sign board and re-rendered GOLDEN CRUST as cream raised letters with a malformed D, where the matching 4:3 render kept both perfectly. 1.0.1 drops the app's sdxl-template prompt suffix with values.quality: on 1 of 2 seeds the suffix ' high quality, detailed, sharp focus.' made the card repaint the wooden sign the prompt said to keep, and it moved both seeds away from the source (frame MAD 26.68/18.49 with it, 14.42/13.57 without; sign region 44.15/13.05 vs 12.68/7.81). With it removed the in-app render is bit-identical to the engine-direct bake on both seeds. VERIFIED IN-APP 2026-10-27 on ComfyUI v0.43.0. PREVIOUSLY NOT TESTED: this pack file inside the app (the engine does not have the nodes yet), the rgthree user-LoRA marker on this graph (vanilla has no rgthree, so it was bypassed for the engine run; the node is byte-identical to the released moss-image card's apart from its model source), multi-reference editing, and the MOSS-Image Base weight. 1.0.2 REMOVES the CFG control, pinning CFG at 1: a user reported the card 'works best on cfg 3-4' and could only reach 2, but that figure belongs to akhaliq/MOSS-Image-Edit-HQ (a different LoRA, edit_format ai-toolkit) and chinoll's model card states no CFG at all. Swept CFG 1/2/3/4 x 30/50 steps x 2 seeds on 2026-10-29 (ComfyUI v0.43.0) on a preservation edit and an ADDITIVE edit: the edit lands fine at CFG 1 (all ten 'add a cat' arms produced the cat at every CFG), and raising CFG only adds collateral damage - the wooden sign the prompt said to keep is unchanged at CFG 1, repainted navy at CFG 2, and retypeset in bold white at CFG 3-4 (keep-region MAD 10.2 / 44.3 / 95.1 / 109.0), while the chalkboard no instruction mentions drifts 14 -> 35 -> 60 -> 75. So the old max of 2 already reached a setting that breaks the card's lettering, which is the reason to use MOSS at all. Steps 30 vs 50 were within ~1 MAD everywhere at 1.6x the time, so the steps control is kept as is. Untested: instructions carrying no 'keep ...' clause.
